VSOL V1600GS Single PON GPON OLT – Compact, High-Performance Optical Line Terminal for Fiber Networks

The V1600GS Single PON GPON OLT is a high-performance optical line terminal designed for GPON (Gigabit Passive Optical Network) deployments. This compact and lightweight device offers a cost-effective solution for fiber-optic network providers looking to offer high-speed internet, VoIP, and IPTV services to residential and small business customers. With 1 GPON port, 2 GE (RJ45) ports, and 1 x 10GE (SFP/SFP+) uplink, the V1600GS ensures fast, reliable, and scalable network connectivity.


Key Features 

  • 1 x GPON Port – Ideal for residential or small business deployments, offering high-speed fiber-optic connectivity.
  • High-Speed Uplinks – Comes with 2 x GE (RJ45) ports and 1 x 10GE (SFP/SFP+) port for fast data transmission and flexible network expansion.
  • Compact Design – The 1U rack-mountable form factor weighs only 1.07kg, making it perfect for environments with space constraints.
  • Energy-Efficient – Designed for low power consumption, the V1600GS helps reduce operational costs while ensuring reliable network performance.


Technical Specifications

  • Model: V1600GS
  • PON Port: 1 x GPON (PX20++)
  • Uplink Ports: 2 x GE (RJ45), 1 x 10GE (SFP/SFP+)
  • Power Supply: AC: 100-240V, DC: -36V to -75V
  • Weight: 1.07 kg
  • Chassis: 1U, rack-mountable
  • Operating Temperature: -20°C to +60°C
  • Storage Temperature: -40°C to +70°C
  • Relative Humidity: 5%–95% (non-condensing)

Ideal Applications

  • FTTH (Fiber-to-the-Home) – The V1600GS OLT is a great choice for delivering high-speed fiber internet to residential users.
  • FTTP (Fiber-to-the-Premises) – Ideal for small businesses needing reliable fiber connectivity.
  • Telecom Operators – Offers scalable and cost-efficient solutions for telecom operators looking to deploy GPON networks.

Why Choose the V1600GS GPON OLT?

  • Compact and Lightweight – Easy to install in small network environments, 1U rack-mounted form factor.
  • High-Speed Connectivity – Features GE and 10GE uplink options for fast and scalable data transfer.
  • Cost-Effective – Low power consumption for reduced operational costs.
  • Future-Ready – Supports GPON technology, ensuring scalable network solutions.
